architecture_overview: R1 collector = new file scripts/lp_long_horizon_r1_real_data_collector_v1.py, reuse R0 adapters (8 files in scripts/lp_long_horizon/adapters/), NOT modify R0 collector. R1 smoke = short run (max_pools=20, max_snapshots=1, no-daemon, 2-3 min), real on-chain data + confidence + honest failure reasons, NOT fallback to 0 placeholder, NOT long-run.
r1_collector_modules: per_chain_protocol_router(pool) — route to adapter callable by chain+protocol
fetch_r1_pool_snapshot(pool, adapter) — live reserve/liquidity/tick + confidence + invalid_reason
fetch_r1_quote_snapshot(pool, adapter, notional_usd) — QuoterV2 staticcall × 6 notional levels

base.confidence_handling: Base RPC unreachable → all confidence=unavailable, invalid_reason=rpc_unreachable

solana.confidence_handling: Meteora dlmm-api unreachable → confidence=unavailable, invalid_reason=indexer_unreachable; others via getMultipleAccountsInfo

r1_failure_handling.how_handle_base_rpc_unreachable: R1 collector探测 1 次 base RPC; 如 403/timeout → 标 base_unreachable=true, 不重试, 不raise; per-pool 写 confidence=unavailable, invalid_reason=rpc_unreachable; summary写 chains_skipped=['base']
r1_failure_handling.how_handle_solana_meteora_rpc_empty: per-pool 调 fetch_meteora_dlmm_state → 返回 None/raise → confidence=unavailable, invalid_reason=indexer_unreachable; 不fallback to 0, 不fallback to placeholder; 其它 Solana 协议 走 getMultipleAccountsInfo 应能拿到
r1_failure_handling.how_handle_bsc_v2_getpair_zero: evm_bsc_pancakeswap_v2.fetch 调 factory.getPair → 返回 0x0...0 → confidence=unavailable, invalid_reason=pool_address_invalid; 不raise, 不fallback; summary写 bsc_v2_pools_excluded=N
r1_failure_handling.how_avoid_fallback_placeholder: R1 不使用 smoke_placeholder flag (R0用, R1不用); 用 confidence=unavailable + invalid_reason='...' 表达失败; 不使用 0/null/"" 作为 fallback; 如拿不到, 直接 unavailable + reason
r1_failure_handling.how_mark_actual_fee_data_available_false: r1_smoke_summary.json: actual_fee_data_available: false (硬编码); fee_proxy_only: true (硬编码, R1 ≠ actual); actual_fee_schema_unchanged: true
r1_failure_handling.how_maintain_read_only: R1 collector 内部不调任何写 chain state 的 RPC (sendTransaction/write API); 全部 RPC 调仅 read-only (getMultipleAccountsInfo, getAccountInfo, eth_call, getLogs read-only); 不调 approve/mint/addLiquidity/removeLiquidity/collect/swap/bridge; 不读 wallet/seed/keypair/signer; write-only 操作 = 写本地 data dir + reports, 不写 production

r1_short_smoke_flow.step_1: load universe (72 pools), sort by chain × protocol
r1_short_smoke_flow.step_2: probe RPC reachability per chain × per endpoint (1 quick check)
r1_short_smoke_flow.step_3: limit to --max-pools=20 (priority: solana_orca > solana_raydium > bsc_v3 > base_* > bsc_v2 > solana_meteora_dlmm_last)
r1_short_smoke_flow.step_4: per pool × per dimension 调 adapter, 1 attempt per call, fail fast

r1_does_not_do: 不启动 tmux / cron / systemd / daemon
不读 wallet / seed / keypair / signer
不 approve / mint / add-liquidity / remove-liquidity / collect / swap / bridge
不覆盖 shadow 原始表
不接 paid RPC / paid indexer
不修改 R0 collector / adapters / RPC registry
不 mint LP NFT (R1 严格 read-only)
